cases.text: The town was a compass. It guided the late walkers home; the same route shone beneath their feet.
The bell was both funeral and reveille: at dusk its toll ended the old shift; at midnight that same toll called the night crew to work.
The promise was a bridge to home. It was a fence keeping her from that same home.
The archive was a mausoleum and a nursery: the same voice was buried there and born there.
